reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Nations Trust Bank PLC resolved to Issue 45,467,286 Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible Shares to both existing Ordinary Voting Shareholders and Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible shareholders by way of a Rights Issue in the proportion of 3 Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible shares for every 22 Ordinary Voting shares and /or Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible shares
reqBaseAnnouncement.nonVotingShrsPropToBeIssued: 3 Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible shares for every 22 Ordinary Voting shares and /or Ordinary Non-Voting Convertible shares
reqBaseAnnouncement.perposeOfTheIssue: To strengthen the Bank’s Common Equity Tier 1 capital position, thereby enabling sustainable growth and greater scale while ensuring that adequate buffers are maintained to absorb heightened risks
